name: c07-making-ad-set
description: Makes a four-frame social ad creative set on the SL8 Image Studio: hook, proof, lifestyle and conversion frames of the same product, each with large clean negative space for copy added later, quoted as one sum before any frame runs. Use it when a brief asks for an ad set, ad creatives for a campaign, or hook, proof, lifestyle and conversion frames, made from text or from a product packshot. It never invents claims, prices or copy. Exact copy the user supplies is composited locally afterwards, or listed as copy still owed. A model renders text only on the user's explicit instruction, recorded as a waiver. The skill runs to the end without asking, fills gaps with stated defaults, quotes every paid step first, and stops at a spend gate rather than overspend.
